workbook: 4. Appendix-II MYT Tariff Formats ARR FY 2026-27.xlsx
note: Revenue from the current tariff, FY2025-26: one row per consumer category, slab or time-of-day block (rows 13–137); per row the total (fixed + energy + minimum + other charges + regulatory discount, O) and the energy and fixed charges per unit it implies (G, H) — for the reviewer to compare with the tariff order's rate schedule, which is not read yet.  Totals: the revenue (O138) the ARR carries as row 15 (L15), the units sold as row 9, the regulatory discount (N138).  The regulatory discount is also computed: 10 % of the energy and fixed / demand charges, the public charging stations' fixed column excluded (revenue_regulatory_discount), against the discount NPCL carries.

blank_is_zero.why: NPCL leaves a charge blank where a slab has none (a time-of-day block has no fixed charge); its row total (O = J + K + L + M + N) and its column sums read the blanks as zero

assumption:regulatory_discount_share.why: the 10 % regulatory discount on energy and fixed charges in force (the order keeps it for FY2026-27: para 7.2.5; Table 8-1 'after Regulatory Discount @10%')

record:rev_fixed_not_demand.why: the LMV-11 public charging stations (PCS-LT, PCS-HT) have no demand charge in the rate schedule ('Demand Charge –', p.381); what NPCL carries in their fixed column is another charge (the penalty for exceeding contracted demand, p.382, by inference), which the regulatory discount does not reach — NPCL discounts their energy charge only
